name: Magnus
install: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && (command -v uv >/dev/null || curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh) && uv sync --extra dev && if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then git config --global credential.helper '!f() { echo username=x-access-token; echo password=$GITHUB_TOKEN; }; f'; fi
